fields.name: title
fields.title: Pickup name
fields.description: Human name of the dropped collectible (XP Crystal / Heart / Grenade / Rune).

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Pickup id
fields.description: Pickup id key (crystal / heart / grenade / runeDrop). Source progression/*.gd managers.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Kind
fields.description: What the pickup grants on collect. Source progression managers.

fields.name: dropRate
fields.title: Drop rate
fields.description: Per-enemy-kill drop chance. Crystal drops on every kill (1.0). Heart ~5% (heart_manager.gd). Grenade 5% (grenade_pickup_manager.gd DROP_CHANCE 0.05). Rune ~0.5% (rune_manager.gd).

fields.name: magnetRange
fields.title: Magnet range
fields.description: Base magnet pull radius in world units before Magnetic / El-Granados multipliers. Crystal 12 (crystal_manager.gd MAGNET_RADIUS), Heart 20, Grenade 20, Rune 0 (deliberate fetch — no magnet).

fields.name: value
fields.title: Value
fields.description: On-collect payload magnitude: crystal XP (tier base 10 .. max 200), heart heal 50 HP (heart_manager.gd HEAL_AMOUNT) + 10 XP, grenade +1 inventory, rune opens the rune-card pick (no numeric value).
